Farming 1. Place outside under open sky and supply empty jars. Farming 10 adds a Catchment Funnel and Raincloth Canopy; Farming 20 adds a Charcoal Water Filter. Install upgrades in the collector slots.
Farming proficiency 10. Compost plant fibers and rotten flesh at a Farm Workbench with a Compost Basket. Used to make inexpensive farm plots; does not apply a growth buff.
Alchemy proficiency 10. Dry herbs at an Apothecary Bench with a Herb-Drying Attachment. Used in prepared meals, medicine and settlement orders.
Alchemy proficiency 10. Dry herbs at an Apothecary Bench with a Herb-Drying Attachment. Used in prepared meals, medicine and settlement orders.

Make a Greenleaf Poultice and an Ember Ward Draught. Train Alchemy with useful medicine and reagents; proficiency 10 opens Apothecary add-ons and 20 opens etched runes and Arbor protection. This ward draught is NOT Arbor smoke protection. Read before crafting; objectives advance in order. These optional lessons do not count toward Wayrest contracts. Recipe knowledge is already available: proficiency, ingredients and the listed station determine access.

Craft a stone shovel, then cobblestones from stone and clay. Mine marked Forest iron, coal and nitrate deposits. Mining proficiency 10 opens the Stone-Cutting Set for the Ore Processing Table; 20 unlocks its branch choices. Read before crafting; objectives advance in order. These optional lessons do not count toward Wayrest contracts. Recipe knowledge is already available: proficiency, ingredients and the listed station determine access.

Make clean water and cooked food, then a repair supply for a focus or wooden weapon. Optional Crafting Tomes cost 500 gold from traders and provide step-by-step lessons. Prepare ammunition or runes for your chosen weapon, carry medicine, and equip any armor class. Settlement gates close on horde night: build and defend your own refuge.
Alchemy 10 at the Apothecary Bench. Reagent for blast and excavation charges.
Alchemy 20 at the Apothecary Bench. Light, then throw. Enemy damage trains Alchemy; +0.5% damage per proficiency above 1. Native fuse and friendly-fire rules apply.
Alchemy 40 at the Apothecary Bench. A powerful excavation explosive. Enemy damage trains Alchemy; +0.5% damage per proficiency above 1. Native terrain damage and fuse apply.

Build base stations at proficiency 1. Install removable add-ons in their ADD-ONS slots at proficiency 10 and 20; backpack tools do not enable station recipes. Farming: Farm Workbench and Rain Collector. Cooking: Field Hearth and Pantry Bench. Smithing: Forest Forge. Carpentry: Carpenter and Outfitting benches. Alchemy: Apothecary and Rune benches. Mining: Ore Processing Table. Basic water and meals need no hearth tool; advanced meals require a pot or grill. See STATION-UPGRADES.txt for the full progression.

Forest recipes use crafting proficiency 1-20, independent of character level. Gather wood, stone, grass, clay and marked ores. Build a refuge with doors and spikes; prepare weapons, armor, ammunition/runes, medicine, food and repair supplies. Build base stations at proficiency 1 and install specialized add-ons at 10 and 20. Gardens supply plants and seeds; wildlife supplies meat, hides and bone. Collect rainwater in clay jars and boil it at the Field Hearth. All recipes through 20 remain available within the Forest. See STATION-UPGRADES.txt for station tools and ingredient routes.
